newsitem.title: USA: Metal Management completes HouTex merger.
newsitem.headline: Metal Management completes HouTex merger.

text.p: Metal Management Inc said Wednesday it completed its previously announced merger with HouTex Metals Co for an undisclosed amount of cash, notes, common stock and warrants.

The company said the deal represents its first acquisition in Texas, where Houtex Metals processes ferrous and non-ferrous scrap metal. The purchase also gives Metal Management an opportunity to build a major regional presence in Texas, company officials said.
Metal Management operates regional metal recycling companies.
